Card Q&A.a: It refers to the positions at 4 and to the right of it on your side.
Card Q&A.q: What positions on the memory gauge does "if you have 4 or less memory" refer to?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] If you have 4 or less memory, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Vegetation] or [TS] trait in the hand without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
